name: step_sound_channel_sequences
description: Advances four audio channel sequences by one tick, reading note bytes and control codes for instrument select, slide, jump and end. When a note is due it loads the sample pointer, length, period and volume into that channel's audio registers and enables its DMA bit.

name: resume_channel_sequence_stepping
description: Re-enters the channel sequence loop at the point where the next channel's note byte is read, writing audio channel registers and DMA enable bits when a note starts and stopping when the channel counter underflows.

name: start_channel_sequences_and_step
description: Clears one channel's sequence state, reads its first note and stores the sequence pointer, then steps every remaining channel until the channel counter underflows, writing audio registers as notes start.

name: load_instrument_and_start_note
description: Selects an instrument from a table using the byte at the sequence pointer, stores its envelope pointers in the channel state, then reads the following note and continues the channel stepping loop.

name: start_first_note_and_step
description: Starts the first note on a channel by scaling its period from the instrument table, then steps all channels and writes their audio registers whenever a note begins.

name: continue_channel_note_stepping
description: Continues the per-channel note loop without setting up a new note, reading the next sequence byte and writing audio channel registers when a note begins.

name: set_channel_slide_and_step
description: Stores a per-tick slide value for the channel, sets its slide-enable flag, and continues the note-stepping loop across all channels.

name: reload_channel_sequence_and_step
description: Reads the next sequence address from the channel's pointer table, restarting the table when its entry is zero, then reads the next note and continues stepping all channels.

name: start_note_with_scaled_period
description: Computes a note period by multiplying a note value by a per-channel scale byte, stores it with the instrument parameters, and writes sample address, length, period and volume to the audio registers before enabling DMA.

name: update_channel_pitch_and_volume
description: Each tick adds the channel slide to its audio period and applies an optional modulation step, writes the period to the audio hardware, and reloads a duration countdown when it reaches its limit.

name: clear_channel_flag_and_step
description: Clears a per-channel state byte and stores its index in the channel table, then continues the stepping loop over all channels.

name: decrement_channel_counter_and_clear
description: Decrements a channel counter and, while it is within the limit, clears the channel's bit 2 flag and zeroes its state byte; otherwise it only zeroes the state byte.

name: reset_channel_counter_and_step
description: Writes the value 60 into a per-channel counter byte, stores its index, and continues stepping all channels.

name: merge_masked_bitplane_words
description: Loops over a block of source words and writes four bitplane words per iteration, where each destination bit is kept or replaced according to a selector word taken from a global table.

name: mask_destination_bitplane_words
description: For each of 160 words, forms a mask from the source word and a global table entry, clears the four destination plane words under the mask, then ORs in the matching source plane bits.

name: store_stack_word_and_call
description: Copies a 16-bit argument from the stack into a global variable, calls another routine, and returns the data and address registers exactly as that routine leaves them.

name: forward_call_to_routine
description: The decompiled body only calls another routine and returns, so this listing shows no other effect of its own. Its 89 instructions are not visible in the pseudo-code.

name: update_mouse_position_clamped
description: Computes signed horizontal and vertical changes from the mouse counter bytes, adds them to the stored position, and clamps the horizontal position to 0 through 639 before halving it. It then calls another routine and returns a masked flag byte.

name: store_mouse_counters_and_call
description: Splits a 16-bit state word into its low and high bytes, stores them in two global counter variables, and then calls another routine.

name: save_state_and_enable_interrupts
description: Saves a 16-bit state word in two global variables and writes a fixed interrupt enable mask to the interrupt enable register.

name: restore_saved_interrupt_enables
description: If a saved flag is set, disables all interrupts, writes back the saved interrupt enable word with its set bit, clears the flag and returns the restored word; otherwise it returns zero.

name: build_copper_display_list
description: Fills a copper instruction list with display window and fetch settings, a 32-entry colour register table, bitplane modulo values, one pointer per bitplane and sprite pointers. It ends the list with a terminator and stores a DMA enable word in a global.

name: set_copper_pointer_then_wait
description: Stores the given address as the copper list pointer, writes its high and low words to the copper location register, then polls the interrupt request read register until bit five is set and returns that masked value.

name: request_and_wait_interrupt_bit
description: Writes the bit five value to the interrupt request register and polls the read-back register until that bit reads as set, then returns the masked bit.

name: patch_copper_colour_entries
description: Scans a copper list for the colour register marker word, then writes a counted block of source words into the entries that follow the marker.

name: report_decompile_timeout
description: No pseudo-code was produced because the decompiler timed out, so only its call relationships are known: it has 21 instructions, is called by one routine and calls one routine.

name: update_record_position_bytes
description: Looks up a record by index and writes its start and end coordinate bytes, a flag byte and their mirrored copies. The coordinates are computed from the two parameters and a global mode value, with high bits set for the flags.

name: decode_keyboard_key_press
description: Turns a keyboard serial byte into an index into a key table of text such as digits and symbols, storing the character once per press and clearing its pending flag on release.

name: copy_eight_thousand_longwords
description: Copies 8000 32-bit values from a source address to a destination address, one after the other.

name: step_nibbles_after_raster_wait
description: Copies a block of words into a stack buffer, then repeatedly waits for a raster position and decrements each nibble of those words, calling another routine on each pass until every nibble is zero. It finishes by calling another routine.

name: call_routine_then_return_result
description: Calls one routine with no arguments, then calls a second routine with the two parameters and returns that second routine's result.

name: call_routine_then_optional_callback
description: Calls a routine with its argument, then calls a second routine only when a global value is nonzero.

name: store_offset_return_high_bits
description: Calls a routine, adds the fixed offset 12345 to its result, stores the sum in a global variable, and returns the upper 15 bits of that stored value.

name: store_high_word_to_global
description: Writes the upper 16 bits of its argument into a global variable and returns. The wider listing shows Amiga library calls, but the decompiled body only stores the word.

name: stub_return_immediately
description: Empty routine that performs a single return and no other operation.

name: allocate_and_initialise_handle_record
description: Allocates a record sized from a table entry, initialises its flags and fields, writes a four-character tag into it and looks up a second record. It then either calls a setup routine or sets flag bits and calls further routines to finish the record.

name: build_argument_text_record
description: Copies a text template into a buffer, sets the record's index field and performs a list of library and wrapper calls that set up its name and data pointers.

name: append_string_bounded
description: Appends a source string to the end of a destination string, copying at most 32767 characters, and writes a terminator if the copy was cut short.

name: append_string_with_limit
description: Finds the end of a destination string, then appends up to a counted number of characters from a source string, writing a terminator when the source was longer than the count.

name: copy_string_padded_to_count
description: Copies a source string into a fixed-size field, stopping at its terminator or after the count, then fills the rest of the field with zero bytes.

name: multiply_low_32_bit_products
description: Multiplies two 32-bit register values using their 16-bit halves and returns the low 32 bits of the product in one register, leaving the second operand in the other.

name: open_named_libraries_and_resources
description: Opens a library named by a global string, looks up a second structure from the argument, and opens further named resources such as a window and the icon library. It stores the handles in the target record and calls a library function on the first handle before returning.

name: call_optional_pointer_then_return
description: Calls a stored function pointer if it is set, then calls another routine and returns.

name: call_optional_pointer_then_routine
description: Calls a stored function pointer if it is set, then calls another routine. The listing is identical to the entry before it.

name: release_program_resources
description: Calls the stored release routines when they are set, runs the library release calls for each handle that is present, and writes a saved value through a pointer. It makes a supervisor call when a status bit in a global byte is set.

name: close_indexed_handle_entry
description: Checks the index against the table size and that its handle is nonzero, closes the handle unless the entry's flag bit is set, then clears the entry and returns zero. Otherwise it stores an error code and returns minus one.

name: call_library_close_vector
description: Calls a library routine at a fixed vector offset from a stored library base, the same mechanism the close wrapper uses.

name: call_library_open_vector
description: Calls a library routine at a fixed vector offset from a stored library base, the same mechanism the open wrapper uses.

name: call_library_vector_via_pointer
description: Calls a library routine at a fixed vector offset from a stored library base pointer, returning nothing.

name: call_library_vector_tail
description: Entry point that enters the middle of the library vector call sequence and calls the routine at a fixed offset from a stored library base.

name: call_library_vector_minus_198
description: Calls the library routine stored 198 bytes below the library base held in a global variable, passing on its result.

name: enter_library_vector_minus_198
description: Enters the same library call sequence as the previous entry, calling the routine 198 bytes below the stored library base.

name: call_library_vector_minus_294
description: Calls the library routine stored 294 bytes below the library base held in a global variable, passing on its result.

name: enter_library_vector_minus_294
description: Enters the same library call sequence as the previous entry, calling the routine 294 bytes below the stored library base.

name: call_library_vector_minus_132
description: Calls the library routine stored 132 bytes below the library base held in a global variable, passing on its result.

name: enter_library_vector_minus_132
description: Enters the same library call sequence as the previous entry, calling the routine 132 bytes below the stored library base.

name: call_library_vector_minus_210
description: Calls the library routine stored 210 bytes below the library base held in a global variable, the same routine the library call wrapper for that offset uses.

name: call_library_vector_minus_372
description: Calls the library routine stored 372 bytes below the library base held in a global variable, passing on its result.

name: call_library_vector_minus_552
description: Calls the library routine stored 552 bytes below the library base held in a global variable, passing on its result.

name: enter_library_vector_minus_552
description: Enters the same library call sequence as the previous entry, calling the routine 552 bytes below the stored library base.

name: call_library_vector_minus_138
description: Calls the library routine stored 138 bytes below the library base held in a global variable, passing on its result.

name: call_library_vector_minus_366
description: Calls the library routine stored 366 bytes below the library base held in a global variable, passing on its result.

name: call_library_vector_minus_384
description: Calls the library routine stored 384 bytes below the library base held in a global variable, passing on its result.

name: call_library_vector_minus_96
description: Calls the library routine stored 96 bytes below a library base pointer held in a different global variable, passing on its result.

name: call_library_vector_minus_78
description: Calls the library routine stored 78 bytes below a library base pointer held in a global variable, passing on its result.

name: save_registers_then_halt_stub
description: Program entry that copies the incoming register contents into global variables, then reaches an unimplemented instruction, so the decompiled control flow stops there. The body is a stub that records state and does not recover further behaviour.

name: save_frame_then_apply_relocations
description: Saves the incoming stack pointer and a set of registers into a frame, then walks a table of offset blocks and adds a base value to the longword at each listed offset until a zero entry ends the block. It finishes by copying 13 words from a fixed code location to a fixed low memory address.

name: apply_relocations_from_table
description: Walks a table of offset blocks and adds a base value to the longword at each listed offset, ending each block at a zero entry. It then copies 13 words from a fixed code location into low memory.

name: apply_relocations_before_max_scan
description: Applies the same offset fixup loop and 13-word copy as its neighbour. Its listing also shows a call to a routine that scans a linked list for a maximum value.

name: copy_words_to_low_memory
description: Copies 13 16-bit words from a fixed code location to a fixed low memory address.

name: spin_delay_counter
description: Busy-waits by decrementing a register counter until it reaches zero, then returns.

name: copy_block_then_scan_list
description: Copies the same 13-word block to a fixed low memory address as its neighbour. Its listing also calls a list scanning routine and two other routines.

name: copy_longwords_then_zero_fill
description: Copies 32-bit values from a source region into a destination region until the destination reaches a limit, zero-fills the remainder, saves the register values into fixed globals and returns the stacked value.

name: report_large_routine_decompile_timeout
description: No pseudo-code was produced because the decompiler timed out on this 403-instruction routine, so only its callers and instruction count are known. It is called by two routines.

name: increment_counter_clear_flag_bit
description: Library code that increments a 16-bit counter in a structure and clears bit three of a flags byte in the same structure.

name: decrement_counter_release_if_flagged
description: Library code that decrements a 16-bit counter in a structure. When the counter reaches zero and bit three of the flags is set, it calls another routine; otherwise it returns zero.

name: unlink_node_or_mark_pending
description: If a count field is zero, removes the structure from a doubly linked list and calls a library vector 210 bytes below the library base. Otherwise it sets bit three of the flags and returns zero.

name: set_pending_flag_bit
description: Library code that sets bit three of a flags byte in a structure and returns zero.

name: open_library_or_alert
description: Stores its arguments in a structure and calls a library function 408 bytes below the library base. On failure it calls the exec alert routine; on success it saves two pointers in global variables.

name: copy_two_longs_to_globals
description: Library code that copies two 32-bit values from a structure into two global variables.

name: forward_to_library_stub
description: Calls another library routine and returns, with no other operation in its listing.

name: forward_to_library_handler
description: Calls another library routine and returns, with no other operation in its listing.

name: forward_to_library_stub_410
description: Library code that calls one other routine and then returns. Its listing has no other operation, so its only effect is whatever the called routine does.

name: forward_to_library_stub_592
description: Library code that calls one other routine and then returns. Its listing has no other operation, so its only effect is whatever the called routine does.

name: call_vector_then_store_longword
description: Library code that calls a routine through a function pointer taken from a fixed table entry, using its first parameter. It then stores the second parameter as a 32-bit value at a fixed offset inside the structure that routine returned.

name: attempt_two_step_call
description: Calls one routine and, when it returns a nonzero value, calls a second routine with that value. If the second call fails, it calls a third routine with the first result and returns zero.

name: fill_icon_structure_from_stack
description: Library code that obtains a structure from one routine, fills it with a second routine, copies ten longwords from a stack buffer into it and stores several fields. When a linked structure is present it writes a back pointer into it, then returns the structure.

name: restore_icon_structure_from_stack
description: Library code that copies ten longwords and several fields from a stack buffer back into a structure, then writes a back pointer into a linked structure when one is present.

name: return_zero_stub
description: Empty library stub that returns zero without doing any other work.

name: build_icon_header_on_stack
description: Library code that writes two fixed words into a stack header, copies ten longwords and several fields from a structure into it, then calls another routine with its first two arguments and a pointer to the header.

name: load_icon_info_file
description: Library code that builds a file name with the info suffix in a 260-byte stack buffer, opens and reads the file through library calls, checks a magic word and version, then fills the icon structure.

name: read_icon_fields_checked
description: Library code that checks the icon magic word and version, then reads the icon's buffers and fields through repeated library calls, stopping at the first failure.

name: read_icon_optional_fields
description: Library code that reads further icon fields through library calls and stores them in the icon structure. It returns 1 when every read succeeds and 0 otherwise.

name: read_icon_word_array
description: Library code that reads a counted series of words into an array through library calls, then reads one more field. It returns 1 on success and 0 on failure.

name: return_zero_after_call
description: Calls another routine and returns zero.

name: empty_library_stub
description: Empty library routine that returns immediately with no work.

name: read_icon_records_into_buffer
description: Library code that allocates a 260-byte buffer and reads the icon's records into it through library calls, then returns a status. It sets an error code when the allocation fails.

name: transfer_icon_fields_via_buffer
description: Library code that allocates a 260-byte buffer, transfers the icon's fields and counted lists through library calls on a handle, and returns a status. It sets an error code when the allocation fails.

name: transfer_icon_fields_info
description: Library code that transfers the icon's fields and counted lists through library calls in sequence, using the info suffix text. It returns zero if any call fails.

name: finish_icon_field_transfer
description: Library code that transfers the optional word lists and pointer fields of an icon structure, then restores a saved value and returns a status.

name: transfer_icon_pointer_table
description: Library code that walks a null-terminated pointer table, transferring each entry and an optional extra entry through library calls, then restores a saved value and returns a status.

name: iterate_icon_table_entries
description: Library code that walks a null-terminated table of pointers, calls a routine for each entry, updates a counter, and calls a callback while it may process a secondary entry.

name: walk_icon_node_list
description: Library code that follows a chain of nodes, calling a routine on each one until the chain ends or returns to its head, then calls a routine on the last node found.

name: forward_call_with_offset_140
description: Library code that calls another routine with the same first argument and the second argument advanced by 140 bytes, then returns.

name: allocate_icon_record_or_release
description: Library code that allocates a 168-byte record, sets a field inside it, and calls routines to fill it. It returns the record on success and releases it on failure.

name: forward_to_two_routines
description: Library code that calls two routines in sequence and then returns.

name: return_zero_status
description: Library routine that returns zero without other work.

name: store_pair_in_counted_slot
description: Library code that decrements a counted slot index in a table header, asks a routine for a new block when the count runs out, then stores two longwords in the slot. It returns one on success and zero when the new block cannot be obtained.

name: store_pair_in_next_slot
description: Library code that decrements a counted slot index, stores two longwords in the table at that slot and returns one.

name: allocate_icon_node_record
description: Library code that allocates a 94-byte record, links it through its fields, and calls routines to initialise it. It returns the record on success and releases it on failure.

name: empty_library_stub_2018
description: Empty library routine with a single return and no other operation.

name: call_routine_and_return_zero
description: Library code that calls another routine and then returns zero.

name: forward_call_with_offset_78
description: Library code that calls another routine with the same first argument and the second argument advanced by 78 bytes, then returns.

name: find_key_equals_value_entry
description: Library code that walks a null-terminated list of string pointers and returns the text after the equals sign of the entry whose key matches the requested key, or zero when no entry matches.

name: scan_list_for_key_equals
description: Library code that scans a null-terminated list of pointers for an entry matching the current key followed by an equals sign, and returns the text after the sign, or zero if none matches.

name: scan_pointer_list_for_key
description: Library code that walks a null-terminated list of pointers and returns the text after the equals sign of the first entry whose key matches, or zero when the list has no match.

name: match_chain_entries_by_count
description: Library code that walks a chain of entries, calling a routine on each, and returns one when a computed count matches the expected value and a final check passes, or zero when the chain ends without a match.

name: verify_chain_entry_count
description: Library code that walks a chain of entries and returns one when the count of entries matches the expected value and the final check passes, or zero otherwise.

name: validate_chain_entry_sequence
description: Library code that walks a chain of entries, checking each entry's computed count against the expected value and returning one when the chain is consistent, or zero when it ends first.

name: confirm_chain_count_match
description: Library code that walks a chain of entries, comparing each computed count with an expected value. It returns one when the count matches and a final check passes, or zero when the chain ends first.

name: search_chain_for_count_match
description: Library code that searches a chain of entries for one whose computed count matches the expected value and passes a final check. It returns one when found and zero when the chain ends.

name: build_copy_name_for_entry
description: Library code that builds the name for a copied item. If the source name has a copy prefix it reads and increments the number after it, otherwise it writes the copy-of text, then stores a 30-byte field length.

name: parse_copy_prefix_number
description: Library code that checks for a three-character copy prefix and parses the decimal digits after it, then calls two routines to finish the update.

name: parse_decimal_digits_check
description: Parses decimal digits at the current text position, then checks a four-character suffix and calls two routines to finish the update.

name: parse_decimal_suffix_for_copy
description: Library code that parses a decimal number from text and, when it is nonzero and the four-character suffix check fails, calls routines to finish. Its text references include copy format strings.

name: decimal_digit_value
description: Converts one character code to its decimal digit value, returning minus one when the character is not a digit.

name: return_minus_one_stub
description: Library routine that returns minus one without other work.

name: call_icon_vector_minus_198
description: Library code that calls the routine 198 bytes below the icon library base stored in a global variable.

name: call_icon_vector_minus_210
description: Library code that calls the routine 210 bytes below the icon library base stored in a global variable.

name: propagate_icon_change
description: Library code that calls a routine with four arguments and, when the result is nonzero, calls it again with the result. If that second call fails, it calls a routine to release the first result and returns zero.

name: allocate_icon_list_entry
description: Library code that allocates a 96-byte record, stores a count of 10 in it and in its first argument, initialises the record through a routine, and returns whether the allocation succeeded.

name: return_zero_stub_138
description: Library routine that returns zero without other work.

name: check_result_equals_argument
description: Library code that calls another routine with three arguments and returns its result when that result equals the fourth argument. Otherwise it returns zero.

name: call_match_result_or_zero
description: Library code that calls another routine with three arguments and returns its result when it equals the fourth argument, otherwise zero. Its listing also calls a library vector 48 bytes below the base.

name: empty_library_stub_226
description: Empty library routine with a single return and no other operation.

name: divide_unsigned_quotient_remainder
description: Unsigned division that returns the quotient and remainder in a register pair. Divisors wider than 16 bits use a 16-step shift and subtract loop, while smaller divisors use 16-bit division.

name: shift_subtract_division_loop
description: Runs the 16-step shift and subtract loop used by the division routine on its register pair, leaving the partial quotient and remainder in place.

name: multiply_low_32_bits_swapped
description: Multiplies two 32-bit register values and returns the low 32 bits of the product in the high register, with the second operand's halves swapped in the low register.

name: call_raw_format_vector
description: Library code that calls a routine through a fixed vector 522 bytes below a library base held in a global variable. The listing identifies it as the text formatting call.

name: store_byte_through_pointer
description: Stores the low byte of the data register through a pointer register, then returns.

name: return_string_length
description: Returns the number of characters before the null terminator of a byte string.

name: find_character_in_string
description: Scans a null-terminated string for a given character and returns a pointer to its first occurrence, or zero when the character is not present.

name: return_zero_stub_38

name: copy_c_string
description: Library code that copies bytes from a source string to a destination until the zero terminator has been copied.

name: append_c_string
description: Library code that moves to the end of the destination string, then copies the source string onto it including its terminator.

name: compare_strings_up_to_count
description: Compares two byte strings for up to a counted number of characters. It returns zero when they match within the count or both end, otherwise one.

name: return_one_stub
description: Library routine that returns one without other work.

name: scan_limited_string_then_call
description: Walks a string while decrementing a limit counter, stopping at the terminator or when the limit runs out. It calls another routine when the terminator is reached.

name: forward_to_string_helper
description: Calls another routine and returns, with no other operation in its listing.

name: copy_string_with_zero_pad
description: Copies up to a counted number of bytes from a source string into a destination, stopping at the terminator and filling the rest of the count with zero bytes.

name: empty_library_stub_162
description: Empty library routine with a single return and no other operation.

name: initialise_list_header_pointers
description: Library code that points a two-pointer list header at itself. It stores the header address, advances the first link by four bytes, clears the next word and stores the header address in the following word.

name: process_icon_request
description: Library code that returns one for a null argument. Otherwise it calls a routine with a 20-byte block and, on success, calls further routines with a pointer taken from the block and returns the final status.

name: process_linked_node_list
description: Library code that walks a linked list of nodes, calling routines on each node's pointer and size fields. It returns one when every node succeeds and zero otherwise.

name: check_all_list_nodes
description: Library code that walks a linked list until its end, calling two routines on each node. It returns one when both calls succeed for every node and zero otherwise.

name: return_zero_stub_212
description: Library routine that returns zero without other work.

name: allocate_icon_block_with_data
description: Library code that allocates a 20-byte record and, when its flag argument is nonzero, allocates a data block and stores its pointer in the record. It returns the record, or minus one when a step fails.

name: return_minus_one_stub_420
description: Library routine that returns minus one without other work.

name: build_linked_node_list
description: Library code that loops over a count, allocating a 16-byte node per iteration and linking it to the previous one. It returns the head node, or minus one when an allocation or call fails.

name: build_linked_node_chain
description: Library code that allocates nodes in a loop, linking each one to the previous node and storing a pointer in each. It returns the first node, or minus one when a step fails.

name: build_node_chain_from_arg
description: Library code that builds a chain of nodes from a stack argument, allocating and linking each node until the chain ends. It returns the first node, or minus one when an allocation or call fails.

name: return_minus_one_stub_632
description: Library routine that returns minus one without other work.

name: create_translator_library_base
description: Library initialisation that allocates a library base through an exec routine, stores the segment and library pointers in it, and then calls another exec routine. It returns minus one when the base was created and zero when the allocation fails.

name: decrement_counter_clear_bit_five

name: scan_text_for_hash_space
